notes.title: PITACOLAB: CALLING ALL PLAYTESTERS!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, GUUUUYS!
[/h2][h3]IT'S OUT!,

[/h3][h3]
[/h3][h3]The first [b]PitacoLab[/b] for our new game, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3780630/"]A Cat in the Cangaço[/url][/b]. This is the time to play and comment! Your feedback will help us improve the game, so don't be shy! To test, just download the corresponding game build from one of the links below:
[/h3][h1][url="https://1drv.ms/u/c/24f1157299e1fb73/ESOWrFF69lNOs_1SUz7bcFgBcG4glcFbR29_txlkWp9-Xw?e=r9hbXi"]Android - Build PitacoLab 001[/url],[/h1][h1][url="https://1drv.ms/u/c/24f1157299e1fb73/EXdIIl-kC3tCqD3lN19a12kBbvZA8ru35vXm2SBYJ9Lkew?e=Baeoh4"]Windows - Build PitacoLab 001[/url],[/h1][h1][url="https://1drv.ms/u/c/24f1157299e1fb73/EVWb44s_n1xHq4PWilOHxN8Bvu5LDGh9p5EhUGwQHhNf1g?e=vZcjue"]Mac - Build PitacoLab 001[/url]
[/h1][p align="start"][b]\[Note for Mac][/b] [i]Since this is an internal testing build only, not the game published in the store, you need to inform MacOS that this is a safe application. [b][url="https://help.gamemaker.io/hc/en-us/articles/216753558-Your-Mac-says-apps-are-damaged-when-downloaded-from-the-internet"]There's a guide on how to do this here[/url][/b].
[/i][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/e3de7510884366d4fd5b0a52ea7de186f5bec1fc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/d18c942df4d9ff83c24a928f14752b70fedc6205.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/0ccd25b7d2fdade9bdc210c70301a2324f6cec69.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]You can also join our Discord server for more insights and follow the development of A Cat in the Cangaço!
[/b][url="https://discord.gg/4uKzEwtqhy" style="button"]CLICK HERE TO ENTER[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #3: Madame Celeste and Zé Fina - Destiny and Mischief in the Magical Back
notes.content: [h3][b]Here comes the mirage, cangaceiros![/b][/h3][p]Today we present the most enigmatic duo in the camp: Madame Celeste Corpo Solto and Zé Fina Rabo Seco.[/p][h2]Madame Celeste: The Truth That Became a Curse[/h2][quote][p]Before: A woman with a full figure, beauty, and charm.[/p][p]The Mistake: She lied about the fate of a married man.[/p][p]Punishment: Condemned to wander as just a head in a dome.[/p][p]Today: She reads letters like someone leafing through a brochure, showing only what suits her.[/p][/quote][p][i]“With Madame Celeste, your word is your weapon.”[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Zé Fina: The Guardian of Destiny[/h2][list][*][p]Blue lizard with a dry tail and bulging eyes[/p][/*][*][p]Witness to 100 years (and 100 stories) of the sertão[/p][/*][*][p]The only remnant of Celeste's previous life[/p][/*][/list][p][i]“If the card is good, thank the wind. If it's bad... sit down and endure.”[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Visual Concept: From Sketch to Magic[/h1][h2]Celeste:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/512e14c087292238d0d2ab2a7e351152360c86b5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/7374323caa6c85ac1a72753b8f10fc79de0bc71e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/ea7d78f16387a3eeea870dc00f562bdd7efbf164.png"][/img][/p][h2]Zé Fina:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/2dc983ecac2b698738116633aa12f515b7c22a28.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/b684d200bc1592379d9544b6851b8b384549d779.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/3374c234f780f016245f1796de90eb9bb848cb79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Next, we'll meet the person who equips our hero with the best weapons![/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #02: Welcome to the Camp!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone! How’s it going?[/b][/p][p]Today, we’re introducing the place where it all begins: [b]the camp![/b][/p][p]This little corner is the heart of our heroic cat’s (Guto’s) journey. It’s where he returns after adventures to upgrade his gear, chat with NPCs, and prepare for the next mission.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/a69f92a25b468328de048cc9d1ab03c0f6545eeb.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]The Camp: Home, Sweet Home (of the Cangaceiro Cat)[/b][/h2][p]The camp is a refuge in the middle of the [i]sertão[/i] (Brazilian backlands).[/p][p][b]Some special spots you’ll find here:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The Armorer’s Tent[/b] – Where you upgrade your weapons and equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Fortune Teller’s Tent[/b] – Mystery and luck run wild here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Balladeer’s Corner[/b] – He tells stories and might even share some valuable tips.[/p][/*][/list][p]And of course, when you’re ready for the next adventure, just use the [i]badogue[/i] (our stylized "fast travel") and dive back into the world![/p][h3][b]Concept Art & Sketches[/b][/h3][p]Here are some early sketches and concepts of the camp and its NPCs:[/p][p][/p][p] You can see we’re putting a lot of care into the visuals and atmosphere to bring that unique blend of [i]cangaço[/i] and fantasy! [/p][h3][b]What’s Next in the Devlog?[/b][/h3][p]In the next post, we’ll introduce each NPC in detail![/p][p]You’ll get to know the [b]Armorer, the Fortune Teller, and the Balladeer[/b]—their personalities, backstories, and roles in the game.[/p][p]So, what do you think of the camp? Any area that caught your eye? Let us know in the comments![/p][p][b]See you soon, companions! The camp awaits… but beware of dusk, when the shadows whisper.[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #01 - Starting this fight!
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Pack, come and see,
Our first update's here – woohoo!
Characters leaping from imagination,
Straight into the game – brand new!
[/p][p]First came the logo (so much debate!),
So many drafts till this final state.
Now here it shines – pure perfection,
Our dream and art in full connection!
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/793399ba6fdfa25da4dc87a7cf22c9ac5283932e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/dcb605a40734a5188ada0576ee10d6b4f8877180.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/b2ba11fcde4506840cfd3fff5a3513947244748a.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]And Cat/Guto? Born from a sketch,[/p][p]Taking form, line by line.[/p][p]Through draft after draft, growing fine –[/p][p]The hero awakes, his power divine!
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/130af8e7eabd1fdc1ab26b6e0a9157803f2fcfc2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/cfadcd6322ebb255d7c8417fd248b72771b58113.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/2fdcc75d5f703919a9f872b2ce1d723c276a480e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/24b268ec13b109506291af8d3910d1823c602365.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/559904695366052fbc80e0d2c5cf008cb103078d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/9835256839016141a330feede87d0319ac5baefd.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/100addecb3a7271bd78c544ea3e411cb3588d01d.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653090/b73afc013dfca391f4bf7ad0a93eb43439f51d41.gif"][/img][/carousel][p]Here's a sneak peek, just for you,
Of the next update coming through!
Stay tuned right here, don't go away,
More magic's coming – hip hooray!
[/p][p]Welcome to CAMP, where you're born anew,
Meet cool characters (not just a few!),
Gear up and choose – the adventure's true![/p][previewyoutube="WjUq95Ez5PM;full"][/previewyoutube]
